instruction: I want each video file to open in a new VLC window instead of replacing the current one. Can you disable single instance mode when starting from files in VLC?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
